EW: Known only to survive in captivity or as a naturalized populations well outside its previous range.
Ex: The species no longer can be found in Georgia, but can be found outside the state.
CR: The species is in imminent risk of extinction in the wild.
EN: The species is facing an extremely high risk of extinction in the wild.
VU: The species is facing a high risk of extinction in the wild.
NT: The species does not meet any of the criteria that would categorize it as risking extinction but it is likely to do so in the future.
LC: There are no current identifiable risks to the species.
DD: There is inadequate information to make an assessment of the risks to this species.
